## Small Case Analysis

The goal is to find the maximum value of $S_N = \sum_{i=1}^{N-1} \frac{x_{i} - x_{i-1}}{x_{i+1} - x_i}$ subject to $x_{i+1} \ge 2x_i$ for $i=1, \ldots, N-1$, and $x_0=0$.

### Case N=3 (Sum up to $i=2$)
$$S_3 = \frac{x_1}{x_2 - x_1} + \frac{x_2 - x_1}{x_3 - x_2}$$
We introduce ratios $a = x_2/x_1 \ge 2$ and $b = x_3/x_2 \ge 2$.
$$S_3 = \frac{1}{a - 1} + \frac{a-1}{a(b-1)}$$
Analytic maximization showed that $S_3$ is maximized when $a$ and $b$ are minimized, i.e., $a=2$ and $b=2$.
Maximum value $S_{3, max} = \frac{1}{2-1} + \frac{2-1}{2(2-1)} = 1 + \frac{1}{2} = 1.5$.

### Case N=4 (Sum up to $i=3$)
$$S_4 = \frac{x_1}{x_2 - x_1} + \frac{x_2 - x_1}{x_3 - x_2} + \frac{x_3 - x_2}{x_4 - x_3}$$
We introduce ratios $a_1 = x_2/x_1 \ge 2$, $a_2 = x_3/x_2 \ge 2$, and $a_3 = x_4/x_3 \ge 2$.
$$S_4 = \frac{1}{a_1 - 1} + \frac{a_1 - 1}{a_1(a_2 - 1)} + \frac{a_2 - 1}{a_2(a_3 - 1)}$$
